items.claim: Navajo Sterling is crafty, technical, and big for the division.
items.quote: Naravo Sterling is crafty. He's technical. He's big for the division as well.

items.claim: Yan Blahovich is very hard to catch on the chin.
items.quote: Yan is so hard to catch on the chin.

items.claim: Yan Blahovich will be able to out low kick and out jab Navajo Sterling at range.
items.quote: I think he's going to be able to sort of out low kick and out jab Navajo Sterling at range.

items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez is dangerous with clobbering power in his hands and nearly put Kevin Holland out.
items.quote: D-Rod's definitely got some clobbering power in his hands and was able to put Kevin Holland nearly out of there in their fight.

items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez swings wildly and runs forward, sometimes swinging from the waist.
items.quote: the way Daniel Rodriguez swings sometimes when he moves forward and he starts running in... swinging from the waist

items.claim: Uros Medic has nasty body kicks including front kicks and round kicks.
items.quote: he's got nasty body kicks, front kicks to the body, round kicks to the body.

items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez has a boxing style that is a little soft to the midsection and vulnerable to body attacks.
items.quote: D-Rod's got a boxing style, a little bit soft to the midsection, a Chano's member of course, chinny to the belly.
